verdict.rationale: Genie and Genie One give business users natural-language Q&A grounded in organizational data, returning SQL, results tables and visualizations. Unity Catalog enforces access control on every query, and UC metric views supply a semantic layer where metrics are defined once and the engine generates the correct computation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that Genie answers are grounded in metric views or the semantic layer to prevent incorrect joins, and independent or hands-on corroboration of answer accuracy.
